name: Activity Timeline
description: Every URLQuery report on one UTC time axis, a lane per data source, under thimble's time range selector, which opens on the data's whole span and zooms from years to single seconds with its viewfinder; colored by confidence, class, disposition, source basis, catalog or a label with thimble's Color by; each report opens in place in the list beside the lanes.

records.name: report
records.one: one URLQuery report, a row of all-reports.csv with its row of report-sources.csv

fields.name: time
fields.how: read as UTC to the second

fields.name: lane
fields.from: data_source, or disposition for a report with no source row
fields.how: the data_source joined on report_id, else Review required or Background control

fields.name: data_source
fields.how: the source row with the same report_id, with its source_basis and matched_sources

fields.name: catalog
fields.how: supplemental when its report_id is listed there, else main

accepts.means: the report on line <n> of all-reports.csv, report-sources.csv or additional-cited-reports.csv, opened in full and shown in its lane

units.means: one lane's reports, such as unctad, review-required or background-control, that lane opened with its reports listed
every report of one UTC day, zoomed to that day
the reports between two UTC times written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, zoomed to that window
one lane's reports on one UTC day, a bar of the overview, the lane opened and zoomed to that day
one lane's reports between two UTC times, a bar once zoomed in, the lane opened and zoomed to that window
